purpose: Apply a zero-call deployable support/abstention risk gate to repaired D321 generation-gap Qwen 3B predictions.

gate_policy.name: conservative_answer_form_and_evidence_overlap_gate
allowed_actions: convert high-risk grounded answers to abstentions
keep low-risk answer forms with inline citations unchanged
compute lexical support features from source question, prediction, and compact evidence pack
keep_rules: yes/no answers with complete inline citations
non-list answers with at least three answer tokens, evidence coverage at least 0.55, and no suspicious placeholder markers

decision.next_step: Run the D322 generation-gap shape harness on gated_predictions.jsonl. Only consider paid judging if the gate passes.
decision.reason: This is a zero-call abstention/support-risk scaffold; shape scoring must come before any paid grounded-correctness judging.
